notes: Ethereum mainnet (1). The constructor mints the entire 1e27 units to its deployer. The launch factory distributes the swarm's 10%, seeds the pool with the 90% allocation, and forwards any remainder to economics.remainderTo. No distribution or administrative powers exist in the token. Transfers sourced from the fixed PoolManager burn floor(amount / 100); other transfers are untaxed. initialPrice is provenance for SIMDTEST as currency0; the launch derives its actual opening price from the economics and deployed currency order.
